processing: White connected backdrop removal at 7% fuzz; alpha eroded one source pixel and feathered 0.35px, original RGB preserved; trimmed and fitted within 1352px, 24px padding, WebP quality 88. Originals retained.
review: Originals and transparent cutouts visually checked on brand tan and dark chocolate at preview scale. No baked text. These are grouped illustrations of the product range, not exact catalogue SKU photographs.

[FORMAT]
Wide 16:9 photographic asset for the right-hand artwork slot of a cookie website header. This is an isolated cutout source, not a full website screenshot.
[LIGHTING]
Large softbox at 45 degrees camera-left, 5000K neutral-warm light, gentle wraparound and a restrained right rim. Internal self-shadows reveal thickness; absolutely no cast shadow on the backdrop.
[LENS & CAMERA]
85mm lens, f/8, three-quarter front view, deep focus across every cookie, true baked texture and uneven handmade edges.
[COLOR PALETTE]
Golden biscuit, toasted almond cream, deep cocoa and restrained raspberry tones; appetising warm colour, no colour cast on white.
[STYLE REFERENCE]
Sculptural asymmetrical food still life, precise editorial staging, tactile crumb and real chocolate texture, controlled studio food photography.
[QUALITY MARKERS]
Tack-sharp commercial photography, hyper-detailed photorealistic rendering, editorial commercial standard, ultra-realistic textures and materials.
[BACKGROUND AND DELIVERY]
All subjects isolated against one perfectly clean pure white #FFFFFF background. No surface, no horizon, no backdrop gradient, no contact shadow; this white is a removable matte for transparent website artwork. Every object fully within frame, generous 12% safe margin on all sides. No typography, logo, package branding or watermark.
[FOCAL SUBJECT]
An exuberant but carefully balanced floating assortment of FIVE thick artisan cookies: two dark double-chocolate chunk cookies, one golden toasted almond vanilla, one pale vanilla white-chocolate chunk, one raspberry coconut with recognisable deep pink raspberry pieces. Match the baked cookie forms, thickness and toppings in the supplied product references; these are flavour references, not layouts. No pinwheel hero cookie.
[COMPOSITION]
A compact diagonal oval cluster offset just right of centre. One large dark cookie anchors the lower middle facing camera, the almond cookie above-left, raspberry cookie upper-right, white chocolate cookie lower-right, smaller dark cookie at back-left. Different subtle rotations and depths; limited overlap preserves recognition of every flavour. A few large dark chocolate chunks between cookies, no overwhelming debris. Freeze a cinematic mid-air moment, grouped into a single clear silhouette occupying 72% of canvas width and 74% height.
[AVOID]
No AI artifacts, warped or smeared text, fake words, plastic look, waxy surfaces, cartoon rendering, people, fingers, melted geometry, doubled subjects, oversaturated HDR, halos, oversharpening, fluorescent flat lighting, harsh on-camera flash, generic stock compositions, unrelated logos, signatures, airbrush look, unrelated flat bands or fake panels, dull gradient zones, clipart, over-staged perfect symmetry, motion blur, haze, flour dust, tiny disconnected crumb clouds or cropped cookies.
